description:
Metabolic Research Center's Caramel Nut Bar is a protein-packed nougat that has been dipped in chocolate and then covered in peanuts and caramel, this dessert-like bar is delicious and satisfying at only 160 calories.

If there’s one place in your entire daily routine that can (and usually does) ruin your dietary goals, snacking is it. Snacks are synonymous with ‘sabotage’, when trying to stay with a routine that melts the pounds away - and they’re everywhere. They usually have little or no protein, little or no fiber, and can be so loaded with sugar that several days’ weight loss efforts can be ruined with a single cheat.

What happens is that the caloric intake of what started out as “well, maybe just one”, can explode into a big number. It’s not really just the calories (which we all need for energy); it’s that most snacks contain calories that are very rapidly released into the bloodstream. That sets off an equally rapid release of insulin (often too rapid), lowering our blood sugar too far. That can quickly increase the appetite, which then can set off a ‘snacking frenzy’ of a truly frightening number of calories.

Well, fear not, ‘cause we got you covered.

Snacks can be important, both to kill your appetite between meals, and to keep you from feeling deprived as you pursue your target weight. Now you can still have that pleasurable break of what would have been a complete ‘junk food cheat’, but using a snack with enough protein, fiber, and even a little fat (which kills appetite far better and longer than carbs) to let you keep your willpower intact.

Our high-nutrition Caramel Nut Protein Bars were designed to help you increase your metabolism, feel full, and manage your hormone levels, so that you're working with your body, not against it.

description: Picky Bars' lighthearted approach to marketing and promotional materials is at stark odds with the actual nuts and bolts (and berries) that inform the science behind the Real Food Energy Bars. If you don't give a fig for that stuff and just want to get fueled and get after it, then by all means just click on the Add to Cart button and enjoy some active nutrition that actually tastes like food. We're into the know-how behind the can-do, though, so we dug through the goods to find out what makes them tick. The ABCs of Picky Bars begin with Agave, end with Walnuts, and are filled out by equally "real" ingredients that target the sweet-spot of a 4:1 ratio of carbs to protein. The most exotic-sounding entry on the list is Pepitas, which are actually just pumpkin seeds, and which Picky Bars suggests help in recovery and metabolizing sugars. The rest of the normal-type foodstuffs are chosen for similar science-y benefits--not even the pedestrian, who-needs-an-excuse chocolate chip is spared from scrutiny (anti-toxin properties that promote blood flow). Of course, if the exhaustive biology informing the ingredient choices isn't enough, just trying one will win you over. They may resemble typical workout bars, but they don't taste like them. They're also dairy-free, gluten-free, soy-free, non-GMO, and vegan, so the only bar to entry is trying to tear the package open with your teeth in the saddle.

If there’s one place in your entire daily routine that can (and usually does) ruin your dietary goals, snacking is it. Snacks are synonymous with ‘sabotage’, when trying to stay with a routine that melts the pounds away - and they’re everywhere. They usually have little or no protein, little or no fiber, and can be so loaded with sugar that several days’ weight loss efforts can be ruined with a single cheat.

What happens is that the caloric intake of what started out as “well, maybe just one”, can explode into a big number. It’s not really just the calories (which we all need for energy); it’s that most snacks contain calories that are very rapidly released into the bloodstream. That sets off an equally rapid release of insulin (often too rapid), lowering our blood sugar too far. That can quickly increase the appetite, which then can set off a ‘snacking frenzy’ of a truly frightening number of calories.

Well, fear not, ‘cause we got you covered.

Snacks can be important, both to kill your appetite between meals, and to keep you from feeling deprived as you pursue your target weight. This makes them a better snack size if you don't like to have big objects in your jersey pocket, or if you simply don't need that much food on your training loop.The more interesting comparison is to Honey Stinger's Energy Bars. description:
Super Moms Need Super Foods

Fire up your super mom powers with these super powered lactation bars. These individually wrapped energy bars are packed full of protein, healthy fats and feature two superherbs: shatavari (to boost lactation) & turmeric (to boost the immune system). The Original flavor is mild and nutty and topped with an almond crunch. The White Chocolate & Cranberries flavor is rich and velvety and sprinkled with crushed pistachios and cranberries.

Maintain your Breastfeeding Diet

On average, it takes 20 calories to make just 1oz of milk. If you are nursing or pumping all day, your body can go through approximately 300-600 calories. Support your breastfeeding and pumping diet with a healthy and nutritious snack - a Mrs. Patel’s Superbar - that will help sustain you throughout the day.

Powerhouse Herbs

The herbs in Mrs. Patel’s Superbars have been traditionally used by nursing mothers for hundreds of years. Shatavari is a full body powerhouse herb that has been known to increase the production of prolactin (the hormone that tells the body to make breast milk) and Turmeric is an adaptogenic herb offering anti-inflammatory and immune-boosting benefits.

A Family-Owned, Mom-Run Small Business

I created Mrs. Patel’s lactation treats and teas to help support moms, like me, who were breastfeeding or pumping. When I breastfed my children, my mom lovingly made lactation treats and teas based on time-tested Ayurvedic recipes passed down - from mother to mother - within our family for generations.

Ayurvedically Inspired

Based on the tenets of Ayurveda (an ancient Indian medicinal system), our ingredients have been used by nursing mothers for thousands of years. We are the only company on the market which makes Ayurveda-based lactation products. Mrs. Patel’s has been used by over 100,000 mothers to help reach their breastfeeding and pumping goals.

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I use the PowerBar Triple Threat bars?
PowerBar Triple Threat bars are a great choice after high intensity training and competition. They contain high quality protein to help build lean muscle and provide sustained energy for athletes participating in high intensity or high endurance activity. Eat one bar after training for best results.

Why do PowerBar Triple Threat bars come in Layered and Crisp varieties?
Athletes love variety and choices. And you can rest assured that whichever PowerBar Triple Threat bar you chose, you will be getting post-exercise nutrition to support recovery.

I have food allergies. Can I eat a PowerBar Triple Threat bars?
PowerBar Triple Threat bars contain peanuts, tree nuts, milk, soy, and wheat. We encourage you to read the label for the most up-to-date ingredients list. If you are allergic to any of these ingredients, this product is not for you.

Will PowerBar Triple Threat bars freeze?
With its open texture, PowerBar Triple Threat Crisp bars can be consumed in cold weather conditions. However, the PowerBar Triple Threat Layered bars do harden in freezing temperatures. Try softening the bar by warming it next to your body for a few minutes or carry it in an inside pocket of your jacket.

How should I store my PowerBar Triple Threat Energy bars?
Store PowerBar Triple Threat bars in a cool, dry place, between 40–70° F. PowerBar Triple Threat bars do not need to be refrigerated. However, storing a PowerBar Triple Threat bar in areas where the temperature exceeds 70° F for an extended period of time will result in significant changes to the taste, texture, color, and coating of the product.

How long will my PowerBar Triple Threat Energy bars last?
Each PowerBar Triple Threat Energy bar is stamped with a "best by" date. We recommend that you use the bar by the “best by” date to ensure you’re getting our best quality product and receiving the full nutritional benefits of the product.

description: 3 bars of nuts and fruit with almonds, apricots and a yoghurt coating ...and nothing dodgy. Dear eat naturalists... If you look up the word 'simple' in the dictionary, you'll come across some pretty odd ways to describe an Eat Natural bar. 'Foolish', 'primitive' and 'ignorant' are few. When it talks about 'the simple life' it describes 'the practice of doing it without luxuries'. Well, it all just goes to show how daft our language can be. Another definition, though, reads 'easily understood', and we like to think that says it all. We reckon, when you've had an Eat Natural Bar, you'll know exactly where we're coming from. It's a pretty obvious idea to us. Just honest, straightforward, wholesome ingredients, like juicy, sun dried apricots, freshly toasted almonds and tropical coconut. All we do, is mix them together into a delicious bar and smother it in a smooth yoghurt coating. That's it...no secret recipe and no surprises. As we'll continue to say here... Simple... isn't it? Down here at the Eat Natural Makery, when we say 'natural', what exactly do we mean? Well, clearly it would be wrong of us to claim that everything in this bar is '100% natural' yoghurt coating, glucose and crisped rice simply don't grow on trees. Obviously, everything needs to be cleaned, dried and roasted too, and therefore, to some extent, 'processed'. It's just that we believe, the less we mess with it...the better it tastes, and why we will never, ever add any dodgy stuff. That means, no artificial flavours or colours and no preservatives.

This makes them a better snack size if you don't like to have big objects in your jersey pocket, or if you simply don't need that much food on your training loop. The more interesting comparison is to Honey Stinger's Energy Bars. They're similarly sized at 50 Gram compared to the 10g Protein Bar's 42g total, and they both have 10 Gram of protein. You can avert this gluconeogenesis (sounds bad doesn't it) and the weakened, sore muscles it causes by providing your body with protein as part of your endurance fuel. description:
On a rainy afternoon in 2003, Beryl Stafford and her daughter “Bobo” baked oat bars that soon became a Boulder, CO cafe favorite. This humble oat bar has since captivated loyal fans nationwide, with no compromise to the original recipe, small-batch baking process, or mother-daughter tradition.

FAQ'S
Where are Bobo’s made?
All of our bars and bites are made in our bakery in Boulder, Colorado.
Are Bobo’s dairy-free?
Yes, all Bobo’s are free of any dairy products.
Are Bobo’s nut-free?
There are several flavors of Bobo’s that contain tree nuts and/or peanuts. Bobo’s has an allergen program in place to prevent cross contact with these allergens, but we recommend that those with allergies to these ingredients exercise caution when eating our products.
Are Bobo’s vegan?
Yes, all of our oat bars are made free of animal products or byproducts.
Are Bobo’s gluten-free?
Every one of our products is certified gluten-free by the GFCO. Our bakery is a gluten-free facility and we undergo daily testing on every batch of our oat bars.
Are Bobo’s Kosher?
All of our bars are certified kosher by Earth Kosher.
Why isn't there more protein in Bobo’s?
While some of our bars may not have a lot of protein, others do. Two of our bars – Almond Butter and Peanut Butter – have 6 grams of protein or more per bar.
Are these safe to eat while pregnant?
As every pregnancy is different, we recommend consulting with a doctor or dietitian to discuss whether our product would be a delicious fit for your prenatal diet!
What is the shelf life for your bars? Can Bobo’s be frozen to extend shelf life?
The shelf life for each bar is 7 months. Bobo’s can be frozen and enjoyed at a later time.


באחר צהריים גשומים בשנת 2003, בריל סטפורד ובתה "Bobo" חטיפי שיבולת שועל אפויים שהפכו במהרה למועדפים על ידי בולדר ושותף. חטיף שיבולת שועל צנוע זה יש מאז אוהדים נאמנים ברחבי העולם, ללא פשרות על המתכון המקורי, תהליך אפייה קטן או מסורת אמא ובת.

שאלות נפוצות
היכן מיוצרים של Bobo?
כל הברים והעקיצות שלנו מיוצרים במאפייה שלנו בבולדר, קולורדו.
האם ללא מוצרי חלב?
כן, כל Bobo's הם ללא מוצרי חלב.
האם ללא אגוזים של Bobo?
ישנם מספר טעמים של Bobo's המכילים אגוזי עץ ו/או בוטנים. ל-Bobo's יש תוכנית אלרגנים במקום כדי למנוע מגע צולב עם אלרגנים אלה, אך אנו ממליצים לאנשים עם אלרגיות למרכיבים אלה יש להיזהר בעת אכילת המוצרים שלנו.
האם Bobo's טבעוני?
כן, כל חטיפי שיבולת שועל שלנו מיוצרים ללא מוצרים מן החי או תוצרי לוואי.
האם ללא גלוטן של Bobo?
כל אחד מהמוצרים שלנו מוסמך ללא גלוטן על ידי GFCO. המאפייה שלנו היא מתקן ללא גלוטן ואנחנו עוברים בדיקות יומיומיות על כל אצווה של מוטות שיבולת שועל שלנו.
האם Bobo's כשר?
כל הברים שלנו מאושרים כשר על ידי Earth Kosher.
למה אין יותר חלבון בבו?
בעוד שלחלק מהחטיפים שלנו אולי אין הרבה חלבון, אחרים עושים. שניים מהחטיפים שלנו – חמאת שקדים וחמאת בוטנים – מכילים 6 גרם של חלבון או יותר בכל חטיף.
האם הם בטוחים לאכול בזמן ההריון?
מכיוון שכל הריון שונה, אנו ממליצים להתייעץ עם רופא או דיאטנית כדי לדון האם המוצר שלנו יהיה התאמה טעימה לתזונה טרום לידתית שלכם!
מהו חיי המדף עבור הברים שלכם? האם ניתן להקפיא את בובו כדי להאריך את חיי המדף?
חיי המדף של כל מוט הם 7 חודשים. ניתן להקפיא ולהנות ממנו בזמן מאוחר יותר.


An einem regnerischen Nachmittag im Jahr 2003 gebackenen Beryl Stafford und ihre Tochter "Bobo" Haferriegel, der bald ein Boulder, CO-Café-Favorit wurde. Dieser bescheidene Haferriegel hat seitdem treue Fans bundesweit, ohne Kompromisse beim Originalrezept, Kleingebacken-Prozess oder der Mutter-Tochter-Tradition einzugehen.

Häufig gestellte Fragen:
Wo sind Bobo's hergestellt?
Alle unsere Bars und Bisse werden in unserer Bäckerei in Boulder, Colorado hergestellt.
Sind Bobo's Milchfrei?
Ja, alle Bobo's sind frei von jeglichen Milchprodukten.
Sind Bobos nussfrei?
Es gibt mehrere Geschmacksrichtungen von Bobos, die Baumnüsse und/oder Erdnüsse enthalten. Bobo's hat ein Allergieprogramm, um Kreuzkontakt mit diesen Allergenen zu verhindern, aber wir empfehlen, dass Menschen mit Allergien gegen diese Inhaltsstoffe Vorsicht beim Verzehr unserer Produkte haben.
Sind Bobo's vegan?
Ja, alle unsere Haferriegel sind frei von tierischen Produkten oder Nebenprodukten.
Sind Bobo's glutenfrei?
Jedes unserer Produkte ist von der GFCO glutenfrei zertifiziert. Unsere Bäckerei ist eine glutenfreie Anlage und wir werden täglich an jeder Charge unserer Haferriegel getestet.
Sind Bobo's Kosher?
Alle unsere Bars sind koscher von Earth Koscher zertifiziert.
Warum gibt es nicht mehr Protein in Bobo's?
Während einige unserer Riegel möglicherweise nicht viel Protein haben, können andere tun. Zwei unserer Riegel - Mandelbutter und Erdnussbutter - haben 6 Gramm Protein oder mehr pro Riegel.
Sind diese sicher zu essen während der Schwangerschaft?
Da jede Schwangerschaft anders ist, empfehlen wir die Rücksprache mit einem Arzt oder Dietizer, um zu besprechen, ob unser Produkt eine köstliche Passform für Ihre fränatale Ernährung wäre.
Was ist die Haltbarkeit für Ihre Bars? Kann Bobo's eingefroren werden, um die Haltbarkeit zu verlängern?
Die Haltbarkeit jeder Riegel beträgt 7 Monate. Bobo's können gefroren und zu einem späteren Zeitpunkt genossen werden.


في فترة ظهيرة ممطرة في عام 2003، أصبح قالب شوفان الخبز بيري ستافورد وابنتها "بوبوبو" الذي سيصبح قريبًا من محبي قهوة بولدر. لقد أسرت قطعة الشوفان المتواضعة هذه منذ ذلك الحين المعجبين المخلصين في جميع أنحاء البلاد، دون التنازل عن الوصفة الأصلية، أو عملية خبز الدفعة الصغيرة، أو تقاليد الأم والابنة.

الأسئلة الشائعة
أين تصنع بوبو؟
جميع القضبان والعض لدينا مصنوعة في مخبزنا في بولدر، كولورادو.
هل منتجات بوبو خالية من الألبان؟
نعم، جميع منتجات بوبو خالية من أي منتجات الألبان.
هل بوبو خالية من الجوزة؟
هناك العديد من نكهات البوبو التي تحتوي على جوز الشجر و/أو الفول السوداني. لدى بوبو برنامج مضاد للحساسية لمنع الاتصال العرضي مع هذه المواد المسببة للحساسية، ولكننا نوصي أولئك الذين يعانون من الحساسية من هذه المكونات بالتعامل مع الحذر عند تناول منتجاتنا.
هل بوبو نباتي؟
نعم، جميع قطع الشوفان الخاصة بنا مصنوعة من منتجات الحيوانات أو المنتجات الثانوية.
هل بوبو خالٍ من الجلوتين؟
كل منتج من منتجاتنا معتمد خالياً من الغلوتين من قبل GFCO. مخبزنا هو منشأة خالية من الغلوتين ونخضع لاختبارات يومية على كل دفعة من قطع الشوفان لدينا.
هل بوبو كوشر؟
جميع القضبان الخاصة بنا معتمدة من قبل إيرث كوشير.
لماذا لا يوجد المزيد من البروتين في بوبو؟
في حين أن بعض ألواح الصابون الخاصة بنا قد لا تحتوي على الكثير من البروتين، فإن بعضها الآخر يفعل ذلك. اثنان من ألواح منتجاتنا - زبدة اللوز وزبدة الفول السوداني - تحتوي على 6 جرامات من البروتين أو أكثر لكل قطعة.
هل هذه المنتجات آمنة للأكل أثناء الحمل؟
نظرًا لأن كل حمل مختلف، فإننا نوصي باستشارة طبيب أو طبيب تغذية ليناقش ما إذا كان منتجنا سيكون ملائمًا لذيذًا لنظام غذائي ما قبل الولادة!
ما هي مدة صلاحية القضبان؟ هل يمكن تجميد بوبو لإطالة عمر التخزين؟
العمر الافتراضي لكل لوح هو 7 أشهر. يمكن تجميد البوبو والاستمتاع بها في وقت لاحق.


Em uma tarde chuvosa em 2003, Beryl Stafford e sua filha "Bobo" assaram barras de aveia que logo se tornaram um favorito do café Boulder, CO. Esta barra de aveia humilde já cativou fãs leais em todo o país, sem comprometer a receita original, processo de cozimento em pequenos lotes ou tradição mãe-filha.

Perguntas frequentes
Onde são feitos da Bobobo?
Todos os nossos bares e mordidas são feitos em nossa padaria em Boulder, Colorado.
Não contém lactose, o Bobo?
Sim, todos os bobos são livres de quaisquer produtos lácteos.
O Bobo é livre de nozes?
Existem vários sabores de Bobo que contêm nozes de árvore e/ou amendoim. O Bobo's tem um programa de alergia em vigor para evitar contato cruzado com esses alérgenos, mas recomendamos que aqueles com alergias a estes ingredientes tenham cuidado ao comer nossos produtos.
O Bobo é vegano?
Sim, todas as nossas barras de aveia são feitas sem produtos animais ou subprodutos.
O Bobo é livre de glúten?
Cada um dos nossos produtos é certificado sem glúten pela GFCO. Nossa padaria é uma instalação sem glúten e passamos por testes diários em cada lote de nossas barras de aveia.
O Bobo's Kosher?
Todas as nossas barras são certificadas pela Earth Kosher.
Por que não há mais proteína no Bobo?
Enquanto algumas das nossas barras podem não ter muita proteína, outras têm. Duas das nossas barras – manteiga de amêndoa e manteiga de amendoim – têm 6 gramas de proteína ou mais por barra.
São seguros para comer durante a gravidez?
Como cada gravidez é diferente, recomendamos consultar um médico ou nutricionista para discutir se o nosso produto seria um ajuste delicioso para sua dieta pré-natal!
Qual é a vida útil dos seus bares? O Bobo pode ser congelado para prolongar a vida útil?
A vida útil de cada barra é de 7 meses. O Bobo pode ser congelado e apreciado depois.


在 2003 年下午,Beryl Stafford 和她的女儿 "Bobo" 烤燕麦吧,很快成为 COCO 博尔德咖啡馆的最爱。 这款谦逊的燕麦条已经吸引了全国各地的忠实粉丝,对原始食谱、小批量烘焙过程或母女传统没有妥协。

常见问题
Bobo's 在哪里制造?
我们所有的棒和零食都在科罗拉多州博尔德的面包店制造。
Boboo 不含乳制品吗?
是的，所有 Bobos 都不含任何乳制品。
Boboo 无坚果吗?
有几种口味波波波茶含有树坚果和/或花生。 Bobo's 已经制定了防止与这些过敏原交互接触的过敏原方案,但我们建议对这些成分过敏的人在食用我们的产品时应谨慎。
波波的素食吗?
是的,我们所有的燕麦条都不含动物产品或副产品。
Boboo 不含麸质吗?
我们的每一件产品都经过 GFCO 认证不含麸质。 我们的面包店是一个无麸质的工厂,我们每一批燕麦棒都经过日常测试。
波波的犹太洁食吗?
我们所有的酒吧均通过 Earth Kosher 认证。
为什么 Bobo's 中没有更多的蛋白质?
虽然我们的一些蛋白棒可能没有很多蛋白质,但也有一些蛋白棒。 我们的两根棒 - 杏仁油和花生酱 - 每条含有6克蛋白质或更多。
怀孕期间可安全食用吗?
由于每次怀孕都不同,我们建议您咨询医生或营养师,讨论我们的产品是否适合您产前饮食!
您的酒吧的保质期是什么? Bobo可以冷冻以延长保质期吗?
每个棒保质期为 7 个月。 Bobo's 可以冷冻并稍后享用。


在 2003 年下雨的下午,Beryl Stafford 和她的女兒「Bobo」烤燕麥棒,很快就成為了 Boulder, CO 咖啡館的最愛。 這款低調的燕麥棒吸引了全國忠實的粉絲,對原始食譜、小批量烘焙過程或母女傳統毫無妥協。

常見問題
Bobo's 在哪裡製造?
我們所有的酒吧和點心都是在科羅拉多州博德的烘焙店製作。
Bobo's 不含乳製品嗎?
是的,所有的 Bobo's 均不含任何乳製品。
Bobo's 不含堅果嗎?
Bobo's 有多種口味,含有堅果和/或花生。 Bobo's 已經制定了過敏原計劃,以防止與這些過敏原交叉接觸,但我們建議對這些成分過敏的人在吃我們的產品時要謹慎。
Bobo's 是素食主義者嗎?
是的,我們所有的燕麥棒都不含動物產品或副產品。
Bobo's 不含麩質嗎?
我們的每一項產品都經過 GFCO 認證。 我們的烘焙坊是一家無麩質設施,我們每天都會對每批燕麥棒進行測試。
Bobo's Kosher嗎?
我們所有的酒吧都通過 Earth Kosher 認證。
為什麼 Bobo's 中沒有更多的蛋白質?
雖然我們的一些棒可能沒有大量的蛋白質,但有些則有。 我們的兩根棒 - 杏仁醬和花生醬 - 每條有 6 克或更多蛋白質。
懷孕時可以安全食用嗎?
由於每次懷孕都不同,我們建議諮詢醫生或營養師,討論我們的產品是否適合您產前飲食的美味選擇!
您酒吧的保存期限是多少? Bobo's 可以冷凍以延長保質期嗎?
每一條的保質期為 7 個月。 Bobo's 可以冷凍並稍後享用。


2003년 비 오는 오후에, 베릴 스태포드와 딸 "Bobo"는 귀리 바를 구웠으며 곧 CO 카페에서 가장 좋아하는 볼더가 되었습니다. 이 겸손한 귀리 바는 전국의 충성스러운 팬들을 사로잡으며 오리지널 레시피, 소량 베이킹 과정 또는 어머니 딸 전통에 대한 타협이 없습니다.

FAQ
Bobo는 어디에 만들어졌나요?
모든 바와 물기는 콜로라도 볼더의 베이커리에서 만들어집니다.
Bobo의 유제품이 없나요?
예, 모든 Bobo에는 유제품이 없습니다.
Bobo의 견과류가 없나요?
견과류 및/또는 땅콩을 포함하는 Bobo의 맛은 여러 가지가 있습니다. Bobo는 알레르기 유발 항원과의 상호 접촉을 방지하기 위한 알레르기 프로그램을 가지고 있지만 이러한 성분에 알레르기가 있는 분들은 제품을 먹을 때 주의하여 운동하는 것이 좋습니다.
보보보의 비건인가요?
예, 저희 귀리 바는 모두 동물성 제품이나 부산물이 없습니다.
Bobo의 글루텐 프리인가요?
당사의 모든 제품은 GFCO에서 글루텐 프리 인증을 받았습니다. 저희 베이커리는 글루텐 프리 시설이며 귀리 바의 모든 배치에 대해 매일 테스트를 거칩니다.
Bobo의 코셔인가요?
모든 바는 Earth Kosher의 코셔 인증을 받았습니다.
왜 Bobo's에 더 많은 단백질이 없을까요?

description:
On a rainy afternoon in 2003, Beryl Stafford and her daughter “Bobo” baked oat bars that soon became a Boulder, CO cafe favorite. This humble oat bar has since captivated loyal fans nationwide, with no compromise to the original recipe, small-batch baking process, or mother-daughter tradition.

FAQ'S
Where are Bobo’s made?
All of our bars and bites are made in our bakery in Boulder, Colorado.
Are Bobo’s dairy-free?
Yes, all Bobo’s are free of any dairy products.
Are Bobo’s nut-free?
There are several flavors of Bobo’s that contain tree nuts and/or peanuts. Bobo’s has an allergen program in place to prevent cross contact with these allergens, but we recommend that those with allergies to these ingredients exercise caution when eating our products.
Are Bobo’s vegan?
Yes, all of our oat bars are made free of animal products or byproducts.
Are Bobo’s gluten-free?
Every one of our products is certified gluten-free by the GFCO. Our bakery is a gluten-free facility and we undergo daily testing on every batch of our oat bars.
Are Bobo’s Kosher?
All of our bars are certified kosher by Earth Kosher.
Why isn't there more protein in Bobo’s?
While some of our bars may not have a lot of protein, others do. Two of our bars – Almond Butter and Peanut Butter – have 6 grams of protein or more per bar.
Are these safe to eat while pregnant?
As every pregnancy is different, we recommend consulting with a doctor or dietitian to discuss whether our product would be a delicious fit for your prenatal diet!
What is the shelf life for your bars? Can Bobo’s be frozen to extend shelf life?
The shelf life for each bar is 7 months. Bobo’s can be frozen and enjoyed at a later time.

FAQ'S
Where are Bobo’s made?
All of our bars and bites are made in our bakery in Boulder, Colorado.
Are Bobo’s dairy-free?
Yes, all Bobo’s are free of any dairy products.
Are Bobo’s nut-free?
There are several flavors of Bobo’s that contain tree nuts and/or peanuts. Bobo’s has an allergen program in place to prevent cross contact with these allergens, but we recommend that those with allergies to these ingredients exercise caution when eating our products.
Are Bobo’s vegan?
Yes, all of our oat bars are made free of animal products or byproducts.
Are Bobo’s gluten-free?
Every one of our products is certified gluten-free by the GFCO. Our bakery is a gluten-free facility and we undergo daily testing on every batch of our oat bars.
Are Bobo’s Kosher?
All of our bars are certified kosher by Earth Kosher.
Why isn't there more protein in Bobo’s?
While some of our bars may not have a lot of protein, others do. Two of our bars – Almond Butter and Peanut Butter – have 6 grams of protein or more per bar.
Are these safe to eat while pregnant?
As every pregnancy is different, we recommend consulting with a doctor or dietitian to discuss whether our product would be a delicious fit for your prenatal diet!
What is the shelf life for your bars? Can Bobo’s be frozen to extend shelf life?
The shelf life for each bar is 7 months. Bobo’s can be frozen and enjoyed at a later time.

The seed grows best in warm climates that have acidic soil and a good drainage system. It has been described as a super food due to its nutritional value and potential benefits to the body. The Sacha Inchi seed contains a high level of protein, and is very rich in omega-3 which the human body cannot produce naturally. Sacha Inchi can be digested easily and is unlikely to cause any allergy and irritation. PLANT DESCRIPTION When planted, Sacha Inchi produces small white flowers which appear in a cluster in its fifth month and bears seed at eight months. The plant produces seed all through the year. The fruits are green when growing, but become black or dark brown when they are ripe. When the plant is some years gone, there may be hundred of fruits to harvest, a hundred fruit produces about 400 to 500 seeds. The seeds are oval-shaped, and measure about 2cm in diameter. Sacha Inchi seeds are usually roasted and eaten as a quality snack. IS SACHA INCHI A NUT? Sachi Inchi is a drupe, which is a fruit surrounding a shell with seeds in it. These seeds form part of what you eat. Sachi Inchi may look like a nut, but it is not and totally unrelated to the legume and nut family. HEALTH BENEFITS OF SACHI INCHI BUILDS IMMUNE SYSTEM Sacha Inchi seeds contain a high level of the tryptophan hormone that helps the brain to release stress and reduce inflammation, which could lead to serious illness; it also reduces depression, fatigue, and memory loss. Maintain your Breastfeeding Diet

On average, it takes 20 calories to make just 1oz of milk. If you are nursing or pumping all day, your body can go through approximately 300-600 calories. Support your breastfeeding and pumping diet with a healthy and nutritious snack - a Mrs. Patel’s Superbar -that will help sustain you throughout the day.

Powerhouse Herbs

The herbs in Mrs. Patel’s Superbars have been traditionally used by nursing mothers for hundreds of years. A Family-Owned, Mom-Run Small Business

I created Mrs. Patel’s lactation treats and teas to help support moms, like me, who were breastfeeding or pumping. When I breastfed my children, my mom lovingly made lactation treats and teas based on time-tested Ayurvedic recipes passed down - from mother to mother - within our family for generations. I am honored to be able to share a part of our family with yours.

Ayurvedically Inspired

Based on the tenets of Ayurveda (an ancient Indian medicinal system), our ingredients have been used by nursing mothers for thousands of years. We are the only company on the market which makes Ayurveda-based lactation products. Mrs. Patel’s has been used by over 100,000 mothers to help reach their breastfeeding and pumping goals.

description:
Honey Stinger's 10g Protein Bars are about half the size of their 20g Protein Bars hence they have half the amount of protein. It goes without saying that the rest of the nutritional information reads at roughly half of the bigger bar. This makes them a better snack size if you don't like to have big objects in your jersey pocket, or if you simply don't need that much food on your training loop. The more interesting comparison is to Honey Stinger's Energy Bars. They're similarly sized at 50 Gram compared to the 10g Protein Bar's 42g total, and they both have 10 Gram of protein. However, the Energy Bar has half again the amount of carbs 8g compared to the Protein Bar's 18g. So the choice is yours to make depending on your preferred ratio of carbs to protein. Like the Energy Bars, the Honey Stinger 10g Protein Bars use nature's energy food, organic honey, as the carbohydrate source. The part that makes honey great for endurance athletes is that it's a just right 1:1 blend of fructose and glucose, two simple sugars that enter the bloodstream quickly to give you a rapid energizing effect as you exercise. They also include whey protein. It's known to have the highest bio availability, so it also acts fast to work for your body. This protein is necessary for muscle recovery after strenuous endurance exercise. But did you know that protein can keep your body from cannibalizing itself during prolonged activity? in addition to burning the stored glycogen in your muscles, your body will get 10-15% of its energy from the breakdown of amino acids in your muscles. You can avert this gluconeogenesis (sounds bad doesn't it) and the weakened, sore muscles it causes by providing your body with protein as part of your endurance fuel. Honey Stinger 10g Protein Bars come in a box of 15. They're available in four flavors -- Dark Chocolate Cherry Almond, Dark Chocolate Coconut Almond, Dark Chocolate Mint Almond, and Peanut Butter.

Honey Stinger 的 10 克蛋白質棒大約是 20 克蛋白質棒尺寸的一半,因此它們含有蛋白質的一半。 不言而喻,其餘的營養資訊會讀取較大營養條的一半。 如果您不喜歡在運動衫口袋裡有大物件,或者您只是訓練環上不需要那麼多的食物,這使它們成為更好的零食尺寸。 更有趣的比較是 Honey Stinger 的能量棒。 與 10 克蛋白質棒的 42 克相比,它們的尺寸相似,為 50 克,它們都含有 10 克蛋白質。 然而,與蛋白質棒的 18 克相比,能量棒再多了一半 8 克碳水化合物。 因此,根據您的偏好碳水化合物與蛋白質比例,您可選擇。 ​ 就像能量棒一樣,蜂蜜棒 10 克蛋白質棒使用大自然的能量食物、有機蜂蜜作為碳水化合物來源。 讓蜂蜜非常適合耐力運動員,那就是它恰到好處的 1:1 混合果糖和葡萄糖,兩個簡單的糖可以快速進入血液中,在運動時給您快速能量效果。 它們還包括乳清蛋白。 眾所周知,它具有最高的生物可用性,因此它也可以快速為身體工作。 ​ 這種蛋白質是激烈耐力運動後肌肉恢復所必需的。 ​ 但您知道蛋白質可以防止您的身體在長時間活動期間吞食嗎? ​ 除了燃燒您肌肉中儲存的糖原,您的身體還將從肌肉中氨基酸分解中獲得其 10-15% 的能量。 您可以通過提供蛋白質作為耐力燃料的一部分,避免這種葡萄糖產生(聽起來很糟糕,不是它)和它引起的虛弱、疼痛的肌肉。 蜂蜜棒 10 克蛋白質棒,一盒有 15 個。 有四種口味 -- 黑巧克力櫻桃杏仁、黑巧克力椰子杏仁、黑巧克力薄荷杏仁和花生醬。

Honey Stinger 的10克蛋白棒的尺寸大约是20克蛋白质的一半,因此蛋白质的一半。 不必说,其余营养信息的读取大约是大蛋白棒的一半。 如果您不喜欢在运动衫口袋里有大物物,或者您只是不需要训练环上的太多食物,这使得它们更适合零食。 与 Honey Stinger 能量棒相比更有趣。 它们的尺寸与10克蛋白质棒的42克总重量相似,它们都含有10克蛋白质。 然而,与蛋白棒的 18 克相比,能量棒的碳水化合物含量增加了一半。 所以您可以根据您碳水化合物与蛋白质的比例进行选择。 与能量棒一样,Honey Stinger 10克蛋白质棒使用自然的能量食物、有机蜂蜜作为碳水化合物来源。 使蜂蜜对耐力运动员来说很棒的是它是一种正确的果糖和葡萄糖 1:1 混合物,两种简单的糖可快速进入血液,在锻炼时为您提供快速的活力效果。 还含有乳清蛋白。 生物利用度很高,因此它也能够快速发挥作用。 这种蛋白质是剧烈耐力锻炼后的肌肉恢复所必需的。 但您知道蛋白质可以在长时间活动期间防止您的身体自食? 除了燃烧肌肉中储存的糖原外,人体将从肌肉中氨基酸的分解中获得10-15%的能量。 通过为您的身体提供蛋白质作为耐力燃料的一部分,您可以避免这种葡萄糖生成(听起来不好),以及它导致的肌肉减弱、酸痛。 Honey Stinger 10 克蛋白棒,每盒 15 个。 有四种口味可选 - 黑巧克力樱桃杏仁、黑巧克力椰子杏仁、黑巧克力薄荷杏仁和花生酱。

Where are Bobo’s made?
All of our bars and bites are made in our bakery in Boulder, Colorado.
Are Bobo’s dairy-free?
Yes, all Bobo’s are free of any dairy products.
Are Bobo’s nut-free?
There are several flavors of Bobo’s that contain tree nuts and/or peanuts. Bobo’s has an allergen program in place to prevent cross contact with these allergens, but we recommend that those with allergies to these ingredients exercise caution when eating our products.
Are Bobo’s vegan?
Yes, all of our oat bars are made free of animal products or byproducts.
Are Bobo’s gluten-free?
Every one of our products is certified gluten-free by the GFCO. Our bakery is a gluten-free facility and we undergo daily testing on every batch of our oat bars.
Are Bobo’s Kosher?
All of our bars are certified kosher by Earth Kosher.
Why isn't there more protein in Bobo’s?
While some of our bars may not have a lot of protein, others do. Two of our bars – Almond Butter and Peanut Butter – have 6 grams of protein or more per bar.
Are these safe to eat while pregnant?
As every pregnancy is different, we recommend consulting with a doctor or dietitian to discuss whether our product would be a delicious fit for your prenatal diet!
What is the shelf life for your bars? Can Bobo’s be frozen to extend shelf life?
The shelf life for each bar is 7 months. Bobo’s can be frozen and enjoyed at a later time.

description:
The Nth Degree. Something taken to the maximum level. In food, that’s amaranth. Or as we like to call it, amaraNth. Amaranth is a naturally gluten-free ancient grain and one of the world's original superfoods, cultivated by the Aztecs thousands of years ago.

Our mission at Nth Degree Snacks is to make amaranth your new favorite food. We are passionate about amaranth because it’s delicious—when popped, it tastes like mini popcorn. The organic amaranth used in Nth Degree Snacks is grown here in the U.S.

Nth Degree Snacks are nutrient-dense and oh-so-good for you, with 5 grams of plant-based protein, 8 grams of fiber, and 7 grams of sugar or less per bar.

Nth Degree Snacks are inspired by alegria, a delicious Mexican snack made with amaranth and honey. Our bars are a modern take on the traditional alegria recipe. Everything about our organic, non-GMO superfood bars will make you feel energized and ready to conquer the world. What will you take to the Nth Degree?

The seed grows best in warm climates that have acidic soil and a good drainage system. It has been described as a super food due to its nutritional value and potential benefits to the body. PLANT DESCRIPTION When planted, Sacha Inchi produces small white flowers which appear in a cluster in its fifth month and bears seed at eight months. The plant produces seed all through the year. The fruits are green when growing, but become black or dark brown when they are ripe. When the plant is some years gone, there may be hundred of fruits to harvest, a hundred fruit produces about 400 to 500 seeds. The seeds are oval-shaped, and measure about 2cm in diameter. Sacha Inchi seeds are usually roasted and eaten as a quality snack. IS SACHA INCHI A NUT? Sachi Inchi is a drupe, which is a fruit surrounding a shell with seeds in it. These seeds form part of what you eat. Sachi Inchi may look like a nut, but it is not and totally unrelated to the legume and nut family. description:
On a rainy afternoon in 2003, Beryl Stafford and her daughter “Bobo” baked oat bars that soon became a Boulder, CO cafe favorite. This humble oat bar has since captivated loyal fans nationwide, with no compromise to the original recipe, small-batch baking process, or mother-daughter tradition.

FAQ'S
Where are Bobo’s made?
All of our bars and bites are made in our bakery in Boulder, Colorado.
Are Bobo’s dairy-free?
Yes, all Bobo’s are free of any dairy products.
Are Bobo’s nut-free?
There are several flavors of Bobo’s that contain tree nuts and/or peanuts. Bobo’s has an allergen program in place to prevent cross contact with these allergens, but we recommend that those with allergies to these ingredients exercise caution when eating our products.
Are Bobo’s vegan?
Yes, all of our oat bars are made free of animal products or byproducts.
Are Bobo’s gluten-free?
Every one of our products is certified gluten-free by the GFCO. Our bakery is a gluten-free facility and we undergo daily testing on every batch of our oat bars.
Are Bobo’s Kosher?
All of our bars are certified kosher by Earth Kosher.
Why isn't there more protein in Bobo’s?
While some of our bars may not have a lot of protein, others do. Two of our bars – Almond Butter and Peanut Butter – have 6 grams of protein or more per bar.
Are these safe to eat while pregnant?
As every pregnancy is different, we recommend consulting with a doctor or dietitian to discuss whether our product would be a delicious fit for your prenatal diet!
What is the shelf life for your bars? Can Bobo’s be frozen to extend shelf life?
The shelf life for each bar is 7 months. Bobo’s can be frozen and enjoyed at a later time.

description:
On a rainy afternoon in 2003, Beryl Stafford and her daughter “Bobo” baked oat bars that soon became a Boulder, CO cafe favorite. This humble oat bar has since captivated loyal fans nationwide, with no compromise to the original recipe, small-batch baking process, or mother-daughter tradition.

FAQ'S
Where are Bobo’s made?
All of our bars and bites are made in our bakery in Boulder, Colorado.
Are Bobo’s dairy-free?
Yes, all Bobo’s are free of any dairy products.
Are Bobo’s nut-free?
There are several flavors of Bobo’s that contain tree nuts and/or peanuts. Bobo’s has an allergen program in place to prevent cross contact with these allergens, but we recommend that those with allergies to these ingredients exercise caution when eating our products.
Are Bobo’s vegan?
Yes, all of our oat bars are made free of animal products or byproducts.
Are Bobo’s gluten-free?
Every one of our products is certified gluten-free by the GFCO. Our bakery is a gluten-free facility and we undergo daily testing on every batch of our oat bars.
Are Bobo’s Kosher?
All of our bars are certified kosher by Earth Kosher.
Why isn't there more protein in Bobo’s?
While some of our bars may not have a lot of protein, others do. Two of our bars – Almond Butter and Peanut Butter – have 6 grams of protein or more per bar.
Are these safe to eat while pregnant?
As every pregnancy is different, we recommend consulting with a doctor or dietitian to discuss whether our product would be a delicious fit for your prenatal diet!
What is the shelf life for your bars? Can Bobo’s be frozen to extend shelf life?
The shelf life for each bar is 7 months. Bobo’s can be frozen and enjoyed at a later time.

description:
On a rainy afternoon in 2003, Beryl Stafford and her daughter “Bobo” baked oat bars that soon became a Boulder, CO cafe favorite. This humble oat bar has since captivated loyal fans nationwide, with no compromise to the original recipe, small-batch baking process, or mother-daughter tradition.

FAQ'S
Where are Bobo’s made?
All of our bars and bites are made in our bakery in Boulder, Colorado.
Are Bobo’s dairy-free?
Yes, all Bobo’s are free of any dairy products.
Are Bobo’s nut-free?
There are several flavors of Bobo’s that contain tree nuts and/or peanuts. Bobo’s has an allergen program in place to prevent cross contact with these allergens, but we recommend that those with allergies to these ingredients exercise caution when eating our products.
Are Bobo’s vegan?
Yes, all of our oat bars are made free of animal products or byproducts.
Are Bobo’s gluten-free?
Every one of our products is certified gluten-free by the GFCO. Our bakery is a gluten-free facility and we undergo daily testing on every batch of our oat bars.
Are Bobo’s Kosher?
All of our bars are certified kosher by Earth Kosher.
Why isn't there more protein in Bobo’s?
While some of our bars may not have a lot of protein, others do. Two of our bars – Almond Butter and Peanut Butter – have 6 grams of protein or more per bar.
Are these safe to eat while pregnant?
As every pregnancy is different, we recommend consulting with a doctor or dietitian to discuss whether our product would be a delicious fit for your prenatal diet!
What is the shelf life for your bars? Can Bobo’s be frozen to extend shelf life?
The shelf life for each bar is 7 months. Bobo’s can be frozen and enjoyed at a later time.

כל הברים והעקיצות שלנו מיוצרים במאפייה שלנו בבולדר, קולורדו.
האם ללא מוצרי חלב?
כן, כל Bobo's הם ללא מוצרי חלב.
האם ללא אגוזים של Bobo?
ישנם מספר טעמים של Bobo's המכילים אגוזי עץ ו/או בוטנים. ל-Bobo's יש תוכנית אלרגנים במקום כדי למנוע מגע צולב עם אלרגנים אלה, אך אנו ממליצים לאנשים עם אלרגיות למרכיבים אלה יש להיזהר בעת אכילת המוצרים שלנו.

כן, כל חטיפי שיבולת שועל שלנו מיוצרים ללא מוצרים מן החי או תוצרי לוואי.

An einem regnerischen Nachmittag im Jahr 2003 gebackenen Beryl Stafford und ihre Tochter "Bobo" Haferriegel, der bald ein Boulder, CO-Café-Favorit wurde. Dieser bescheidene Haferriegel hat seitdem treue Fans bundesweit, ohne Kompromisse beim Originalrezept, Kleingebacken-Prozess oder der Mutter-Tochter-Tradition einzugehen.

Häufig gestellte Fragen:
Wo sind Bobo's hergestellt?
Alle unsere Bars und Bisse werden in unserer Bäckerei in Boulder, Colorado hergestellt.
Sind Bobo's Milchfrei?
Ja, alle Bobo's sind frei von jeglichen Milchprodukten.
Sind Bobos nussfrei?
Es gibt mehrere Geschmacksrichtungen von Bobos, die Baumnüsse und/oder Erdnüsse enthalten. Bobo's hat ein Allergieprogramm, um Kreuzkontakt mit diesen Allergenen zu verhindern, aber wir empfehlen, dass Menschen mit Allergien gegen diese Inhaltsstoffe Vorsicht beim Verzehr unserer Produkte haben.
Sind Bobo's vegan?
Ja, alle unsere Haferriegel sind frei von tierischen Produkten oder Nebenprodukten.
Sind Bobo's glutenfrei?
Jedes unserer Produkte ist von der GFCO glutenfrei zertifiziert. Unsere Bäckerei ist eine glutenfreie Anlage und wir werden täglich an jeder Charge unserer Haferriegel getestet.
Sind Bobo's Kosher?
Alle unsere Bars sind koscher von Earth Koscher zertifiziert.
Warum gibt es nicht mehr Protein in Bobo's?
Während einige unserer Riegel möglicherweise nicht viel Protein haben, können andere tun. Zwei unserer Riegel - Mandelbutter und Erdnussbutter - haben 6 Gramm Protein oder mehr pro Riegel.
Sind diese sicher zu essen während der Schwangerschaft?
Da jede Schwangerschaft anders ist, empfehlen wir die Rücksprache mit einem Arzt oder Dietizer, um zu besprechen, ob unser Produkt eine köstliche Passform für Ihre fränatale Ernährung wäre.
Was ist die Haltbarkeit für Ihre Bars? Kann Bobo's eingefroren werden, um die Haltbarkeit zu verlängern?
Die Haltbarkeit jeder Riegel beträgt 7 Monate. Bobo's können gefroren und zu einem späteren Zeitpunkt genossen werden.


في فترة ظهيرة ممطرة في عام 2003، أصبح قالب شوفان الخبز بيري ستافورد وابنتها "بوبوبو" الذي سيصبح قريبًا من محبي قهوة بولدر. لقد أسرت قطعة الشوفان المتواضعة هذه منذ ذلك الحين المعجبين المخلصين في جميع أنحاء البلاد، دون التنازل عن الوصفة الأصلية، أو عملية خبز الدفعة الصغيرة، أو تقاليد الأم والابنة.

الأسئلة الشائعة
أين تصنع بوبو؟
جميع القضبان والعض لدينا مصنوعة في مخبزنا في بولدر، كولورادو.
هل منتجات بوبو خالية من الألبان؟
نعم، جميع منتجات بوبو خالية من أي منتجات الألبان.
هل بوبو خالية من الجوزة؟
هناك العديد من نكهات البوبو التي تحتوي على جوز الشجر و/أو الفول السوداني. لدى بوبو برنامج مضاد للحساسية لمنع الاتصال العرضي مع هذه المواد المسببة للحساسية، ولكننا نوصي أولئك الذين يعانون من الحساسية من هذه المكونات بالتعامل مع الحذر عند تناول منتجاتنا.
هل بوبو نباتي؟
نعم، جميع قطع الشوفان الخاصة بنا مصنوعة من منتجات الحيوانات أو المنتجات الثانوية.
هل بوبو خالٍ من الجلوتين؟
كل منتج من منتجاتنا معتمد خالياً من الغلوتين من قبل GFCO. مخبزنا هو منشأة خالية من الغلوتين ونخضع لاختبارات يومية على كل دفعة من قطع الشوفان لدينا.
هل بوبو كوشر؟

Em uma tarde chuvosa em 2003, Beryl Stafford e sua filha "Bobo" assaram barras de aveia que logo se tornaram um favorito do café Boulder, CO. Esta barra de aveia humilde já cativou fãs leais em todo o país, sem comprometer a receita original, processo de cozimento em pequenos lotes ou tradição mãe-filha.

Perguntas frequentes
Onde são feitos da Bobobo?
Todos os nossos bares e mordidas são feitos em nossa padaria em Boulder, Colorado.
Não contém lactose, o Bobo?
Sim, todos os bobos são livres de quaisquer produtos lácteos.
O Bobo é livre de nozes?
Existem vários sabores de Bobo que contêm nozes de árvore e/ou amendoim. O Bobo's tem um programa de alergia em vigor para evitar contato cruzado com esses alérgenos, mas recomendamos que aqueles com alergias a estes ingredientes tenham cuidado ao comer nossos produtos.
O Bobo é vegano?
Sim, todas as nossas barras de aveia são feitas sem produtos animais ou subprodutos.
O Bobo é livre de glúten?
Cada um dos nossos produtos é certificado sem glúten pela GFCO. Nossa padaria é uma instalação sem glúten e passamos por testes diários em cada lote de nossas barras de aveia.
O Bobo's Kosher?
Todas as nossas barras são certificadas pela Earth Kosher.
Por que não há mais proteína no Bobo?
Enquanto algumas das nossas barras podem não ter muita proteína, outras têm. Duas das nossas barras – manteiga de amêndoa e manteiga de amendoim – têm 6 gramas de proteína ou mais por barra.
São seguros para comer durante a gravidez?
Como cada gravidez é diferente, recomendamos consultar um médico ou nutricionista para discutir se o nosso produto seria um ajuste delicioso para sua dieta pré-natal!
Qual é a vida útil dos seus bares? O Bobo pode ser congelado para prolongar a vida útil?
A vida útil de cada barra é de 7 meses. O Bobo pode ser congelado e apreciado depois.


在 2003 年下午,Beryl Stafford 和她的女儿 "Bobo" 烤燕麦吧,很快成为 COCO 博尔德咖啡馆的最爱。 这款谦逊的燕麦条已经吸引了全国各地的忠实粉丝,对原始食谱、小批量烘焙过程或母女传统没有妥协。

常见问题
Bobo's 在哪里制造?
我们所有的棒和零食都在科罗拉多州博尔德的面包店制造。
Boboo 不含乳制品吗?
是的，所有 Bobos 都不含任何乳制品。
Boboo 无坚果吗?
有几种口味波波波茶含有树坚果和/或花生。 Bobo's 已经制定了防止与这些过敏原交互接触的过敏原方案,但我们建议对这些成分过敏的人在食用我们的产品时应谨慎。
波波的素食吗?
是的,我们所有的燕麦条都不含动物产品或副产品。
Boboo 不含麸质吗?
我们的每一件产品都经过 GFCO 认证不含麸质。 我们的面包店是一个无麸质的工厂,我们每一批燕麦棒都经过日常测试。
波波的犹太洁食吗?
我们所有的酒吧均通过 Earth Kosher 认证。
为什么 Bobo's 中没有更多的蛋白质?
虽然我们的一些蛋白棒可能没有很多蛋白质,但也有一些蛋白棒。 我们的两根棒 - 杏仁油和花生酱 - 每条含有6克蛋白质或更多。
怀孕期间可安全食用吗?
由于每次怀孕都不同,我们建议您咨询医生或营养师,讨论我们的产品是否适合您产前饮食!
您的酒吧的保质期是什么? Bobo可以冷冻以延长保质期吗?
每个棒保质期为 7 个月。 Bobo's 可以冷冻并稍后享用。


在 2003 年下雨的下午,Beryl Stafford 和她的女兒「Bobo」烤燕麥棒,很快就成為了 Boulder, CO 咖啡館的最愛。 這款低調的燕麥棒吸引了全國忠實的粉絲,對原始食譜、小批量烘焙過程或母女傳統毫無妥協。

常見問題
Bobo's 在哪裡製造?
我們所有的酒吧和點心都是在科羅拉多州博德的烘焙店製作。
Bobo's 不含乳製品嗎?
是的,所有的 Bobo's 均不含任何乳製品。
Bobo's 不含堅果嗎?
Bobo's 有多種口味,含有堅果和/或花生。 Bobo's 已經制定了過敏原計劃,以防止與這些過敏原交叉接觸,但我們建議對這些成分過敏的人在吃我們的產品時要謹慎。
Bobo's 是素食主義者嗎?
是的,我們所有的燕麥棒都不含動物產品或副產品。
Bobo's 不含麩質嗎?
我們的每一項產品都經過 GFCO 認證。 我們的烘焙坊是一家無麩質設施,我們每天都會對每批燕麥棒進行測試。
Bobo's Kosher嗎?
我們所有的酒吧都通過 Earth Kosher 認證。
為什麼 Bobo's 中沒有更多的蛋白質?
雖然我們的一些棒可能沒有大量的蛋白質,但有些則有。 我們的兩根棒 - 杏仁醬和花生醬 - 每條有 6 克或更多蛋白質。
懷孕時可以安全食用嗎?
由於每次懷孕都不同,我們建議諮詢醫生或營養師,討論我們的產品是否適合您產前飲食的美味選擇!
您酒吧的保存期限是多少? Bobo's 可以冷凍以延長保質期嗎?
每一條的保質期為 7 個月。 Bobo's 可以冷凍並稍後享用。


2003년 비 오는 오후, Beryl Stafford와 그녀의 딸 "Bobo"는 곧 콜로라도 볼더가 가장 좋아하는 코로라도 카페가 되었습니다. 이 소박한 귀리 바는 전국의 충실한 팬들을 사로잡아 왔으며, 오리지널 레시피, 소량 배치 베이킹 과정 또는 어머니딸 전통에 대한 타협이 없습니다.

자주 묻는 질문
Bobo는 어디에서 만들어집니까?
저희의 모든 바와 물기는 콜로라도 볼더에 있는 베이커리에서 만들어집니다.
Bobo의 유제품이 없나요?
네, 모든 Bobo에는 유제품이 없습니다.
Bobo는 너트가 없나요?
나무 견과류 및/또는 땅콩을 포함하는 보보에는 여러 가지 맛이 있습니다. Bobo's는 알레르기 유발 항원과의 교차 접촉을 방지하기 위한 알레르기 유발 항원 프로그램을 운영하지만, 이러한 성분에 알레르기가 있는 분들은 제품을 먹을 때 주의해야 할 것을 권장합니다.
Bobo의 비건인가요?
네, 모든 귀리 바에는 동물성 제품이나 부산물이 없습니다.
보보의 글루텐 프리인가요?
당사의 모든 제품은 GFCO에서 글루텐 프리 인증을 받았습니다. 저희 베이커리는 글루텐 프리 시설이며 귀리 바의 모든 배치에 대해 매일 테스트를 거칩니다.
보보의 코셔인가요?
모든 바는 Earth Kosher의 코셔 인증을 받았습니다.
보보에 단백질이 더 많지 않을까요?
저희 바 중 일부는 단백질을 많이 함유하지 않을 수도 있지만, 다른 바에서는 그렇습니다. 두 개의 바 - 아몬드 버터와 땅콩 버터 - 바 당 6g 이상의 단백질을 함유하고 있습니다.
임신 중에 먹기에 안전한가요?
임신이 다르기 때문에 의사 또는 영양사와 상담하여 임산부 식단에 맛있게 맞을지 논의하는 것이 좋습니다.
바의 유통 기한은 어떻게 되나요? 보보는 유통 기한을 연장하기 위해 얼릴 수 있습니까?
각 바의 유통 기한은 7개월입니다. Bobo는 나중에 냉동 및 즐길 수 있습니다.

description:
On a rainy afternoon in 2003, Beryl Stafford and her daughter “Bobo” baked oat bars that soon became a Boulder, CO cafe favorite. This humble oat bar has since captivated loyal fans nationwide, with no compromise to the original recipe, small-batch baking process, or mother-daughter tradition.

FAQ'S
Where are Bobo’s made?
All of our bars and bites are made in our bakery in Boulder, Colorado.
Are Bobo’s dairy-free?
Yes, all Bobo’s are free of any dairy products.
Are Bobo’s nut-free?
There are several flavors of Bobo’s that contain tree nuts and/or peanuts. Bobo’s has an allergen program in place to prevent cross contact with these allergens, but we recommend that those with allergies to these ingredients exercise caution when eating our products.
Are Bobo’s vegan?
Yes, all of our oat bars are made free of animal products or byproducts.
Are Bobo’s gluten-free?
Every one of our products is certified gluten-free by the GFCO. Our bakery is a gluten-free facility and we undergo daily testing on every batch of our oat bars.
Are Bobo’s Kosher?
All of our bars are certified kosher by Earth Kosher.
Why isn't there more protein in Bobo’s?
While some of our bars may not have a lot of protein, others do. Two of our bars – Almond Butter and Peanut Butter – have 6 grams of protein or more per bar.
Are these safe to eat while pregnant?
As every pregnancy is different, we recommend consulting with a doctor or dietitian to discuss whether our product would be a delicious fit for your prenatal diet!
What is the shelf life for your bars? Can Bobo’s be frozen to extend shelf life?
The shelf life for each bar is 7 months. Bobo’s can be frozen and enjoyed at a later time.
